text: A Metro ticket costs £2. How much do three tickets cost?
You face north and turn right. Which way are you facing now?
why: A right turn from north points you east.

text: Write STOP backwards, then put an S on the front. What word have you made?
why: STOP backwards is POTS, and S in front makes SPOTS.

text: Which square number lies between 20 and 30?
A team wins 5, draws 3 and loses 2. With 3 points for a win and 1 for a draw, how many points have they got?
A clock is 10 minutes fast. It shows five to three. What's the real time?
why: Five to three, take away 10 minutes, is quarter to three.

text: How many squares on a chessboard are not on its outside edge?
why: Take the outer ring away and a 6 × 6 square of 36 is left.

text: Which two-digit number is exactly three times the sum of its own digits?
why: 2 + 7 = 9, and 3 × 9 = 27. No other two-digit number works.

text: I'm a whole number over 10. Half of me is a square number, and so is twice me. What's the smallest I can be?
why: Half of 18 is 9 (3 × 3) and double 18 is 36 (6 × 6). 8 also works, but it's under 10.
